data.name: The sgn function
data.content:
---
down:
  - "[[Definitions (absolute value)]]"
  - "[[Properties (the sgn function)]]"
tags:
  - mathemagics/real_analysis
---
Let $\operatorname{sgn}:\mathbb{R}\to\{-1,0,1\}$ be
$$
\operatorname{sgn}(a)=
\begin{cases}
1, & a>0,\\[2pt]
0, & a=0,\\[2pt]
-1,& a<0.
\end{cases}
$$
